0.q: ABA or CBF-pathway marker genes were substantially higher in PwNAC2 transgenic Arabidopsis.

1.q: ABA or CBF-pathway marker genes were substantially higher in PwNAC2 transgenic Arabidopsis.

2.q: Transgenic seeds inhibited to a lesser extent [by ABA]; seedlings also showed decreased sensitivity to ABA treatment; over-expression of PwHAP5 in Arabidopsis athap5 mutant enhanced tolerance to ABA.

3.q: PwHAP5 plays a role in pollen tube growth orientation by interaction with PwFKBP12 in Picea wilsonii Mast.

4.q: PwRFCP1 (Resemble-FCA-contain-PAT1 domain), an interaction protein of PwNAC2 was screened via yeast two hybrid. Luciferase complementation assay confirmed the interaction in vivo and bimolecular fluorescence complementation assay showed the interaction in nucleus.

5.q: Under drought or salt treatment, overexpression of PwNAC2 in Arabidopsis showed more vigorous seed germination and significant tolerance for seedlings by ROS scavenging, reducing of membrane damage, slower water loss and increased stomatal closure.
